subject: Follow-up: Fair-share evening demo windows for NovaCorp
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Tanner <alex.tanner@novacorp.com>
Cc: Sofia Mendes <sofia.mendes@novacorp.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0500
Subject: Follow-up: Fair-share evening demo windows for NovaCorp

Alex / Sofia — thanks again for the call today. Quick post-call recap and proposed next steps so we can lock a technical deep dive/demo: 

Summary (30s):
- Goal: 45–60m technical deep dive into inference latency, data residency, and routing/rollout controls.
- Primary audience: NovaCorp infra and platform engineers (APAC-heavy); leadership will sit in for first 20 min.
- Constraint: APAC engineers can only join after 20:00 SGT local time most days.

Proposed next step: schedule the deep dive and a rotating cadence so we share evening coverage fairly across Redwood and NovaCorp. I attached a simple availability matrix for Q4 (availability_matrix_q4.xlsx) and our suggested rotation patterns.

Three fair-share windows (all times shown in local + UTC for clarity):
1) APAC-evening window (preferred by your team): 20:00–21:00 SGT (12:00–13:00 UTC) — good for Asia-based engineers.
2) US-friendly overlap: 08:00–09:00 PST (16:00–17:00 UTC) — puts the demo in the morning for US devs and late afternoon for EU.
3) Rotating late-day window: 18:00–19:00 CET (17:00–18:00 UTC) — alternates exposure across regions week-to-week.

Ask for you: which of the three windows best matches your core audience for the first session? If APAC-evening (1) works, can we pick two candidate dates next week so I can send a single invite?

Logistics I will include when I send the invite: agenda (first 20m exec overview, 30–40m tech deep dive), pre-read (nova_demo_flow.pdf), and GCal invite (gcal-invite.ics).

Thanks — will align our PM/engineer coverage based on your preference.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0184

Attachments: availability_matrix_q4.xlsx, nova_demo_flow.pdf

From: Alex Tanner <alex.tanner@novacorp.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Mendes <sofia.mendes@novacorp.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 09:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Fair-share evening demo windows for NovaCorp

Thanks Logan — helpful recap. Quoting below and adding details from our side.

We definitely need the session outside working hours for our APAC infra team; option 1 (20:00–21:00 SGT) is ideal. For the first technical deep dive, two constraints: please include someone who can speak to latency tuning and KV cache behavior under bursty traffic, and we need a short section on data residency controls (KMS/HSM integrations).

Candidate dates (our preference order):
- Tue 16 Nov, 20:00 SGT / Tue 16 Nov 12:00 UTC
- Thu 18 Nov, 20:30 SGT / Thu 18 Nov 12:30 UTC (if Tue is full)

We're happy with a rotating cadence after the first session (week 1/2 rotation between our APAC and EU teams). I've attached our internal availability export and a short note on participants (we'll have two engineers + product manager).

Appreciate you coordinating.

— Alex
Alex Tanner
Head of Platform Engineering | NovaCorp
alex.tanner@novacorp.com
Attachments: novacorp_availability_export.csv

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0500
Subject: Fwd: Follow-up: Fair-share evening demo windows for NovaCorp — coverage ask

Team — forwarding Alex's preference (APAC-evening, Tue 16 Nov preferred). Key asks from the customer: someone to present latency tuning + KV cache behavior and a short demo of routing/fallback for region/capacity.

Can we cover this as follows?
- Soojin: lead the session and handle product overview + routing/fallback (first 20m).
- Rafael: lead the technical deep dive on latency/kv cache behavior and quantization tradeoffs (30–35m).
- Marissa: join the start for intros and ensure we have escalation SLAs handy.

If we make this a rotating evening window for NovaCorp, proposed rotation plan: Soojin covers week 1, Rafael week 2, (then repeat) — we’ll keep Marissa as the escalation backup. That keeps on-call strain low and gives NovaCorp consistent engineering context.

Two quick asks:
1) Rafael — can you confirm you can do Tue 16 Nov at 20:00 SGT (that is Tue 12:00 UTC / Mon 07:00 PST) and that you have the demo environment to show KV cache behavior under burst conditions?
2) Soojin — I’ll draft the invite and include the short pre-read; can you attach the routing/fallback one-pager?

Quoted for context:
> From: Alex Tanner <alex.tanner@novacorp.com>
> Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 09:10:00 +0000
>
> Thanks Logan — helpful recap... (see his full reply above)

— Logan

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Tanner <alex.tanner@novacorp.com>, Sofia Mendes <sofia.mendes@novacorp.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Fair-share evening demo windows for NovaCorp — confirmed 16 Nov

Alex / Sofia — thanks for confirming preferences. We locked Tue 16 Nov at 20:00 SGT (12:00 UTC). Calendar invite attached (gcal-invite.ics) and a short agenda below.

Agenda (45m):
- 0–5m: intros (NovaCorp + Redwood)
- 5–25m: Exec overview & routing/fallback patterns (Soojin)
- 25–45m: Technical deep dive: latency tuning, KV cache behavior, quantization tradeoffs (Rafael)
- 45–60m: Q&A + next steps and rotation cadence

Rotation plan (operational): Soojin covers week 1 (16 Nov), Rafael week 2, rotate thereafter. Marissa is escalation backup for both sessions. I'll also publish a shared calendar with the alternating slots and a short runbook (link: https://drive.redwood.com/s/shared/novacorp-demo-plan).

Next steps for you (Alex): please share the list of attendees and any specific files you want Rafael to exercise in the demo. If anything changes on your side we can push to Thu 18 Nov (20:30 SGT) as an alternative.

See you on 16 Nov — I’ll send the Google Calendar invite from my account in the next 20 minutes.

— Logan
